title: Record the v1.0.0 promotion and orchestrate the next parallel cycle
purpose: Replace the obsolete pre-release governance checkpoint with a canonical state bound to the promoted Learn-it v1.0.0 baseline. Record the CI maintenance lane from issue #85 as active, accessibility work from issue #86 as deferred, the independent analyses from issues #88 through #91 as complete, and issue #95 as the mandatory accountable-owner decision gate while all product implementation remains on HOLD.
